iowa_mis.license: Official source statement: recordings may be downloaded and used for any projects, without restrictions
iowa_mis.notes: 2011/2012 string sessions provide 24-bit/96-kHz stereo material recorded in an anechoic chamber with Earthworks QTC-40 microphones. Primarily isolated notes; do not treat as real legato-phrase data. Preserve a source/terms snapshot and file hashes in provenance.

tinysol.notes: 2913 isolated notes across 14 instruments. Use only violin/viola/violoncello. TinySOL is ordinary-technique material and requires attribution.

vsco2_ce.notes: CC0 and legally permissive, but the repository string layout includes section material for viola/cello rather than a matched four-soloist Q4 corpus. Do not feed it into the HQ acoustic renderer by default. Optional for articulation taxonomy/LIVE preview experiments only.

descript_dac.license: MIT; upstream README states released model weights are under MIT

custom_owned_session.notes: This entry becomes release-eligible only for a specific session after a signed performer/master agreement grants commercial ML training, derivative model/weights creation and redistribution/sublicensing, commercial generated outputs, and processing/segmentation rights. Never flip this registry flag without storing the signed clearance path in provenance.

slakh2100.notes: Synthetic sample-library stems; never use as the final timbre target. It is rendered/sample-library material, so it never counts toward the 80% real-acoustic lane.

philharmonia_samples.license: Custom terms: samples may be used in commercial works but not sold or made available as-is or as a sampler instrument; ML-weight redistribution is not explicitly addressed
philharmonia_samples.notes: Do not train a release model until written permission explicitly covers commercial ML training and redistribution of learned weights.

urmp.license: No explicit commercial ML-training plus learned-weight redistribution grant verified

quartset_2025.license: Zenodo dataset record exposes the data but no explicit license text sufficient for commercial ML-training/weight redistribution was verified

musc.license: Linked performance audio rights are not cleared for commercial model training

musopen.license: Per-recording review required; do not bulk-assume public domain or ML-training rights

good_sounds_cora_2025.notes: Use only the 2025 CORA distribution and record DOI/version/file hashes. 15 professional musicians; studio recordings; single notes and scales. Public dataset descriptions report 48-kHz/32-bit mono source files. Filter to good-sound/scale-good and violin/cello. Do not mix with the older Zenodo distribution without separate provenance.

good_sounds_legacy_zenodo.notes: Legacy copy has non-commercial terms. The v0.3 pipeline explicitly distinguishes it from the 2025 CORA CC-BY-4.0 distribution.

mid_fild_midi.notes: MIDI only, not acoustic training. Contains string_violin/string_viola/string_cello/string_double_bass classes plus role/mood/min_cc/max_cc metadata. Useful to pretrain performance-control priors without contaminating audio timbre.

fsd50k_cc0_strings.license: Per-clip; only CC0 clips may be admitted by the optional filter
fsd50k_cc0_strings.notes: Do not use as final timbre target. FSD50K contains mixed licenses; pipeline must whitelist CC0 at clip level and bowed-string labels only.

sanidha.notes: Studio-quality Carnatic multitracks, ~8h total. Violin has two clean multitracks per concert. Use as acoustic/bow-continuity supplement only; suppress/ignore style-specific pitch ornament conditioning so Carnatic gamaka does not leak into Mandarin-ballad performance style. Access currently requires Georgia Tech guest/VPN request.

ghent_ar_violin_2023.notes: Use Avatar_Data professional First/Second Violin leader stereo WAV + motion/joint-angle data preferentially. Participant recordings are amateurs and are excluded from final timbre training by default.

musicnet_audited.license: Per-recording Creative Commons/Public Domain provenance; commercial pipeline must whitelist only CC0/PD/CC-BY recordings and retain track provenance.
musicnet_audited.notes: Zenodo describes 330 freely licensed recordings; OpenAIRE indexes the record as CC BY. Audio provenance spans Creative Commons/Public Domain sources. v0.8 still retains track/source provenance and hashes rather than discarding them. Use primarily for real chamber context/realism critic, not isolated CC3/legato supervision.

wikimedia_pd_quartets.notes: Seed list contains only files whose Commons pages explicitly show public-domain dedication/CC0. Downloader rechecks extmetadata at runtime and refuses non-PD/non-CC0 files. Use ensemble mix for realism reference, not isolated instrument timbre.

openmic_2018.license: CC-BY-4.0 dataset package; retain original track metadata/attribution
openmic_2018.notes: 10-second naturally occurring music excerpts with violin/cello labels. Mixed audio only. Optional weak critic/reference data, never a primary timbre target.

violet_csv_td.license: VIOLET code MIT; CSV-TD dataset page states license is still being worked on/coming soon as of 2026-08-30; audio was rendered with a commercial virtual instrument.
violet_csv_td.notes: Do not ingest CSV-TD or its checkpoints into commercial release weights until explicit data/checkpoint rights are verified. Architecture ideas may be clean-room reimplemented from the MIT code/paper.

vibrato_analysis_research.license: Dataset page states software AGPLv3; embedded audio comes from multiple owners and the record does not provide a single commercial ML/weight-redistribution grant.
vibrato_analysis_research.notes: Technically valuable: violin material includes no/slow/standard/fast vibrato and pitch-trajectory annotations. Do not train release weights on its audio. Use only as a research reference for deterministic vibrato measurement design.

violin_technique_2024.license: Indexed as CC BY, but files are currently restricted and the record was published for reviewers; release use requires obtaining the files with the applicable terms/evidence.
violin_technique_2024.notes: Excellent note+technique annotations if access/rights are clarified. Do not bypass restricted access.

sorbonne_violin_acoustics_2025.license: Etalab Open License 2.0 (dataset page marks it compatible with CC-BY 2.0).
sorbonne_violin_acoustics_2025.notes: Very small 2025 set containing live violin, bowing-machine open strings and hybrid synthesis for violin acoustics evaluation. Useful for codec/physics validation, not enough for phrase/transition learning.

bach_violin_audited_subset.license: PER-RECORDING LICENSES; each audio file retains the license of its original source.
bach_violin_audited_subset.notes: 6.5 h / 17 violinists with score alignments is valuable for phrase, legato and vibrato mining, but the collection has mixed per-recording rights. Admit only individually audited recordings into a new source id after preserving each original license snapshot/hash. MP3/OPUS and varied rooms make it unsuitable as the primary timbre anchor.

mit_bowstroke_database_research.license: The Zenodo record is the CC-BY-4.0 conference paper, not a blanket license for the underlying bowstroke audio/gesture database.
mit_bowstroke_database_research.notes: Technically excellent for bow-force/position/gesture and bowstroke timing; do not use underlying audio/gesture data for commercial weights until the actual database files carry explicit compatible rights.

wikimedia_violin_techniques_ccby25.license: CC-BY-SA-2.5 / GFDL multi-license on inspected vibrato file; ShareAlike implications for learned weights are not cleared
wikimedia_violin_techniques_ccby25.notes: v0.7 correction: do not admit audio into commercial checkpoints until legal review resolves ShareAlike treatment of model weights/derivatives. Metadata may still be referenced.

arme_virtuoso_strings.license: CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0; repository COPYRIGHT states non-commercial research/educational use only
arme_virtuoso_strings.notes: Technically excellent: professional Q4, solo/duet/trio/quartet tracks, onset annotations, normal/deadpan/speed conditions. Do not use in commercial weights without separate permission.

string_performance_dataset_spd.license: No explicit commercial ML/learned-weight redistribution license verified on public project page
string_performance_dataset_spd.notes: Violin/cello audio plus dense body/hand/instrument/bow motion and contact annotations. High technical value for bow-change physics, but rights gate remains closed.

violin_midi_performance_2023.license: Dataset record provides aligned MIDI/pitch-bend data, but explicit per-record Rights/license was not captured in this audit; repository code is AGPL-3.0 and MIDI is aligned to external YouTube performances
violin_midi_performance_2023.notes: 34h-equivalent aligned solo-violin performance descriptors with 5.8ms/10-cent resolution and pitch bends. Do not transfer derived performance labels into release weights until dataset rights are explicitly verified.

single_sound_clarity_strings.license: Record asks for attribution/citation but an explicit standard commercial reuse license was not verified in this audit
single_sound_clarity_strings.notes: Bowed/plucked violin and cello audio; useful for spectral validation, not admitted to commercial training until license is explicit.

violin_spherical_mic_2022.license: No license text shown in the Zenodo Rights field as verified 2026-08-30.
violin_spherical_mic_2022.notes: 2.9GB, 32 spot microphones, 23 expressions; technically valuable, but not admitted without an explicit commercial-compatible data license.

violin_midi_highres_2024.license: Dataset record provides aligned MIDI with 5.8ms/10-cent pitch-bend trajectories, but an explicit commercial-compatible record license was not verified; linked performance audio remains on YouTube and is never harvested.
violin_midi_highres_2024.notes: Potentially excellent symbolic vibrato/intonation teacher. Never download or train on linked YouTube audio. Enable only after MIDI dataset rights are explicitly confirmed.

vibrato_dataset_skx300.license: Repository code is Apache-2.0, but embedded audio/ground-truth provenance is mixed across CMMSD/Coler/other material; repository license alone is not treated as an audio rights grant.

orchideasol.license: Audio governed by IRCAM Forum License; metadata CC-BY-4.0.
orchideasol.notes: Do not confuse metadata CC BY with the audio terms.

open_music_archive_pd.license: Per-recording; only explicit Public Domain items may enter the commercial pipeline. BY-SA items are excluded by default.
open_music_archive_pd.notes: Historical recordings can help realism statistics, not modern close-mic timbre. Require per-file source URL, rights statement and hash.

synthetic_cleanroom_bowed_v18.license: SONICRAFT-generated audio from independently authored physical DSP; permissive open-source projects may be used only as reference/validation and their audio/weights are not copied.
synthetic_cleanroom_bowed_v18.notes: Hard-capped by the v1.8+ origin-aware sampler to 20% probability mass. v1.9 Sound Forge may grade/rank it only inside the modeled lane. Codec adversarial realism uses real rows only, and modeled reconstruction is down-weighted; modeled data must never become the final timbre anchor. No SWAM audio, binaries, AMData, presets, weights or decompiled material are used.
